notes.title: QoL Update
notes.notes:
Hey players!

We’ve rolled out a little Quality of Life update to make your escape experience smoother:

🔸 Pause Menu Upgrade – Now you can check the game rules and control keys directly from the pause menu. No more guessing on the run!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/406bb65b41f488ed852ca7352e35cb492577870a.png


🔸 Exit Zone Hints – Added subtle visual cues to guide you toward the level’s exit. Escaping the maze just got a tiny bit easier. (By the way, check out our personal record for completing the first level—it’s in the top-right corner of the screenshot. Can anyone beat it?)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45082956/182aeeded3cbc4d7ceb4dcab11c29c8d356b048c.png


Let us know what you think, and happy escaping! 🌀

– The FSTR Team
